headline.text: Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹3,00,904 cr, EBITDA ₹36,572 cr (12.2% margin), PAT ₹20,895 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 16.0% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹1,35,979 cr → ₹2,85,874 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 11.8% was the slowest in 5 years.
EBITDA margin compressed by 210 bps over FY23–FY26 (14.8% → 12.7%).
PAT compounded at 8.0% a year over FY21–FY26, lagging revenue.
Debt-to-equity was 1.24 at FY27 end (1.35 at FY24).
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow was 1.15× reported profit (₹86,099 cr vs ₹75,124 cr) — profits are turning into cash.

citations.section: Operating cash flow FY26 not located on a page

claims.text: Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 5 of the last 5 years, ₹67,047 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹19,052 cr, 22% of operating cash flow (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle lengthened from -172 to -151 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 15% in FY26 (12% in FY23).

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

statements.speaker: Priyankar Biswas
statements.quote: My first question is for the 10% to 12% growth that you have guided in the Lakshya plan, that is till FY31.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: The global economy is entering calendar 2026 with growth expected to remain modest at roughly the 3% range.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: This is already factored into our PM margin guidance for FY '26.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: The Return on Assets remained healthy at 2.31% for Q3 FY '26 and adequate capital is available in the balance sheet to pursue growth in the medium term.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: Before we conclude, let me cover the guidance on the various parameters for FY '26: On order inflows - Our nine months order inflow has seen a strong growth of 30% Y-on-Y based on a strong capex momentum.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: Basis the 9-month performance and the healthy prospects pipeline for the near term, we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: On Margins - Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: Lastly, on Working Capital - We had earlier guided the Net Working Capital to Revenue of 12% by March '26.

statements.speaker: Mohit Kumar
statements.quote: I think at the beginning of the year, we had given 15% revenue growth guidance.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: So we continue to retain our guidance of 15% for the full year, and we are reasonably confident that Q4, the way we have planned, the execution momentum will be at a fast forward pace, both for the Infrastructure -- for all the segments in the Projects & Manufacturing space.

statements.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
statements.quote: So Sumit, just to add, I did emphasize that the margin guidance of 8.5% remains the effort for taking into account that we have had a good 9 months despite the fact of Hydrocarbon margins having moved southwards this year.
